Description

Spectacular Five-Bedroom Home with Panoramic Camps Bay Views

Set high above Camps Bay on the highly sought-after Theresa Avenue, this impressive triple-storey residence occupies a substantial 1,229m² erf and enjoys truly spectacular panoramic views across Camps Bay and the Atlantic Ocean.

Positioned towards the top of Camps Bay, the home takes full advantage of its elevated setting, with breathtaking views enjoyed from almost every room in the house. From sunrise to sunset, the surrounding mountains, coastline and ocean create an incredible backdrop to everyday living.

Read More

A large gated driveway welcomes you onto the property, offering an impressive sense of arrival and generous space within the grounds.

Spanning three levels, the home offers five well-proportioned bedrooms and three-and-a-half bathrooms, providing ample accommodation for a family while offering excellent potential to create a truly exceptional Camps Bay residence.

The property’s elevated position and generous proportions allow the views to remain a constant feature throughout the home, with expansive outlooks over the suburb and towards the Atlantic beyond.

At the lower end of the 1,229m² property, a private garden and swimming pool provide a tranquil outdoor setting, ideal for entertaining, relaxing and enjoying Cape Town’s renowned summer lifestyle.

Theresa Avenue remains one of Camps Bay’s most desirable residential addresses, offering a peaceful position above the suburb while remaining conveniently located for Camps Bay Beach, the Promenade, restaurants, schools and the surrounding Atlantic Seaboard.

With its substantial erf, five-bedroom accommodation, commanding position and extraordinary panoramic views, this is a rare opportunity to secure a significant property in one of Cape Town’s most sought-after coastal neighbourhoods.
